title: Carasent publishes Annual Report for 2024
content:
Carasent has released its 2024 Annual Report, available in Swedish and English on the company website, along with an ESEF file in Swedish format.

Contact information:
- Daniel Öhman, CEO: +46 70-855 37 07
- Svein Martin Bjørnstad, CFO: +47 979 69 493

The press release notes this disclosure fulfills requirements under the Securities Markets Act.
